verdict.rationale: Whether an operating system's source can be read under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Windows source code being published under an open license. The docs cover app SDKs, consumer features and support topics, and the community items discuss unrelated UX and update complaints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
